devdoc.details: No common insurance pool, short exposure, pooled LP claims, or synthetic profit promise. Loans are non-recourse: losses consume borrower equity, then lender debt. Oracle and venue semantics must be reviewed independently; pinning proxy code does not pin its implementation.

settleInKind(uint256).details: Agreed conversion is the ENTRY price, rounded UP for lender and capped by held base. This is an in-kind close, not a current valuation or promise to recover the quoted debt.

close(uint256,uint112,uint48).notice: Borrower may close any time; anyone may close at maturity or maintenance breach.

repay(uint256).notice: No oracle or trading route is needed to repay the fixed debt and recover all base.

settleInKind(uint256).notice: Deterministic terminal delivery after grace, even if oracle/venue permanently fails.

withdrawFor(address,address).notice: Anyone can relay a withdrawal; its recipient is fixed to the credited account.

userdoc.notice: Isolated, lender-funded spot leverage. Each position holds its own purchased base.
